title: Top product not sold in this customer's region -- excluded automatically, next best offered instead

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Ines -- how can I help today?
Hi, my colleague in Spain mentioned a savings account paying good interest, do you have that here too?
Let me check what's actually available in your country -- offers can differ by market.
Ah, I didn't realise that varied, that makes sense.
Right, some products are market-specific. Let me see what we do have for you.
Okay, I'm open to alternatives if the savings one isn't available here.
Appreciate the flexibility -- give me just a moment.
Thanks for your patience -- here's what I'd recommend for your account.
That works, thank you for explaining.
Glad to help -- thanks for calling, have a great day!
